shadow.why: The owner's decision of 2026-10-18: paper-trade the lab's best near miss as an unofficial experiment. Its lab verdict stays failed; it is never eligible for Ready, the arena, the fleet or live money.

throttle._doc: off: the book's own drawdown brake (target.params brake_dd 15%, brake_days 28) is its drawdown control, as in the lab

approval._doc: mode never: no human approval anywhere; tiers in auto_tiers execute on their own at any hour, other tiers are recorded as refused and not traded. mode online_hours: the earlier model (proposals 10-22 local, offline_auto_tiers overnight).

target._funding_doc: history: the paper ledger accrues Hyperliquid's actual hourly funding of each name (funding_history) on its value at the mark, longs paying and shorts receiving; the rate read once a day times 24 hours drifted by more than a point of return in the lab's replay
target._stop_doc: No per-name risk stop (the lab's book mode). The engine never holds a position without a resident stop, so each name carries a catastrophic one 100% beyond its average entry: a short closes if its price doubles; a long's sits at zero. In the lab's replay since 2024-01 it fired once (a short); a 50% stop fired 22 times. Paper only: it protects no exchange position (docs/specs/SHADOW.md).

_agent_note: SHADOW EXPERIMENT, paper only, never live: lab recipe ls-759fac45 (ls_xs: residual momentum against Bitcoin, 21 days, market-neutral long-short on the top 30 Hyperliquid perps by volume, 20%/yr portfolio volatility target, 15%/28-day book drawdown brake). Its lab verdict is failed (the worst-regime floor). docs/specs/SHADOW.md.
